title: Frank–Wolfe physical-link flow
caption: Saved Ithaca static Frank–Wolfe endpoint for 11:00–12:00 local activity. The map and 22-bin histogram use the same complete 15,148-link physical-flow vector, including 12,789 exact-zero links; 2,359 links exceed 1e-6 PCE. Flow is PCE accumulated during the declared one-hour period, not persons or flow per simulation time step. The map uses a square-root sequential color scale with original-unit ticks and gray road context; histogram counts are linear and no links are omitted. Turn, access and other nonphysical solver arcs are excluded. Only the saved iteration-0 initialization exists; FW performed zero subsequent updates. Reciprocal directed arcs may overlap geometrically; flows are not summed. This is a modeled engineering scenario, not observed traffic. © OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL 1.0.

panels.a: All retained physical geography with true terminal per-link flow; virtual arcs excluded
panels.b: 22-bin histogram of the same complete flow vector, including exact zero and near-zero links
